A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose an efficient method of video similarity retrieval based on motion activity features in compressed domain, and a novel similarity measure between video sequences that considers the spatio-temporality variation through consecutive frames.
the motion activity of video shots can be used as a high-level semantic feature for fast similarity retrieval.
the proposed mechanism can be used to improve the performance of video sequence matching and retrieval.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the semantic features of motion activity can be effectively described by the 3D histogram, which is sensitive to the variation of spatio-temporal moving objects.
